mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no as orderNo, alipay_order_no as alipayOrderNo, buyer_id as buyerId, seller_id as sellerId, product_id as productId, total_amount as totalAmount, status, pay_time as payTime, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_deleted as isDeleted FROM `order` WHERE 1=1 AND buyer_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
